```{r, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE}
source(here::here("_rinit.R"))
invisible(Sys.setlocale("LC_TIME", "en_US.UTF-8"))
invisible(Sys.setenv(TZ = "America/Los_Angeles"))
# cd ~/iCloud/website/data; /usr/local/bin/R -e 'quarto::quarto_render("index.qmd")'
# cd ~/iCloud/website/data; /usr/local/bin/R -e 'quarto::quarto_render("themes.qmd")'
# sh ~/iCloud/website/website_short.sh
themes <- list.files(pattern = "\\.qmd$") %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  rename(theme = value) %>%
  mutate(theme = gsub("\\.qmd$", "", theme)) %>%
  filter(theme != "api", theme != "index", !grepl("_update", theme))
```

# By Language

## English

```{r, echo = F}
themes %>%
  mutate(Title = read_lines(paste0(theme, ".qmd"), skip = 1, n_max = 1) %>% gsub("title: ", "", .) %>% gsub("\"", "", .)) %>%
  mutate(Compile = as.Date(file.info(paste0(theme, ".html"))$mtime),
         Compile = glue::glue("[{Compile}](https://fgeerolf.com/data/{theme}.html)")) %>%
  filter(textcat(Title) == "english") %>%
  gt::gt()|>
  gt::fmt_markdown(columns = "Compile") |>
  gt::opt_interactive(
    use_search = T,
    use_resizers = T,
    use_compact_mode = T
  )
```
